LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.Intro: Where each garment class stops on the body. 0 is the hem, 1 is the top of the head. TailorMade's own values are 0.58, 0.20 and 0.45. Lower the first if trousers ride above the navel on a body drawn without legs.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.Scope: Global settings, shared by every save. Changes apply when this window closes.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.PantsTopTi: The height of the waistband, as a fraction of the body: 0 is the hem, 1 is the top of the head. TailorMade's value is 0.58.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.BootsTopTi: How far up the body footwear is drawn, as a fraction of the body's height. TailorMade's value is 0.20.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.ChestBotto: Where the lower edge of a chest piece lands, as a fraction of the body's height. TailorMade's value is 0.45.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.ShortenShi: TailorMade only bands a torso garment whose art already starts 40% of the way up, which leaves a vanilla shirt, drawn over the whole body, full length and hiding the trousers entirely. This lifts that test for on-skin garments, and the chest slider above then decides where they stop. Coats, parkas and robes are worn on the shell layer and still drape to the ankles. The shirt is compressed into the band, not cut off at it, so collars and buttons are squeezed along with it.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.UseGeneral: AB's Visible Pants draws its trousers as a plain shell. General Textures Collection carries a retexture of the same garment with a waistband, belt loops and a fly, but only loads it when XeoNovaDan's Visible Pants is active. With AB active instead, this reads those textures from General's installed folder. Nothing is copied. It needs General Textures Collection to be installed.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.DetailShel: Draw details on plain trouser shells
Where there is no such retexture - a child, or a body type General does not cover - draws a waistband, a fly and seams onto AB's plain shell, and parts the legs at the bottom.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.TrouserDro: Moves the trouser art down the body, as a fraction of its height. 0 leaves it where it was drawn. It only applies to the trousers this mod supplies, meaning General Textures Collection's art and the details drawn onto AB's shells.
The same, for a child. It is a separate value because a child is drawn smaller, so the same fraction of the picture is fewer pixels on screen.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.ArtNeedsRe: These three trouser options take effect when the game starts, not when this window closes. For the trousers this mod supplies, TailorMade does not fit them into a band, so the pants slider above does not apply to them; with both options off it does.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.PatchDirec: Patched at the source: changes show as soon as this window closes.
LanguageData.TailorMadeWaistlines.Settings.PatchFallb: Running on the fallback patch: close the game and start it again for a change to show, because TailorMade's cached textures were keyed on the old value.
